{{Quote|Master Kota was a military genius, but felt that clone soldiers were unfit for battle. Instead, he relied on his own militia.|[[PROXY]]|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] '''Militia''' was a unique combat [[unit]] of battle-hardened [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that fought in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] accepted high-ranking [[Jedi General/Legends|positions]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Kota refused to have anything to do with the new [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone Army]]. He neither trusted the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] nor saw them as effective soldiers. Hence, Kota recruited a small but effective army from local [[Militia/Legends|militias]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups and even [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war.

When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] betrayed and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] officers. Most of Kota's Militia, however, remained loyal to their [[General/Legends|General]]. They disappeared into hiding during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], but later re-emerged to take up arms against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; eventually evolving into the basic soldiers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Overview==
The [[Militia/Legends|Militia]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were clad in [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[uniform]]s that resembled those that would later be worn by the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFU2n">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> Most [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]], [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. Elite members were issued heavier armor and [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannons]].<ref name="TFU databank" /> Furthermore, the Militia possessed several commandeered [[Multi-Altitude Assault Transport|MAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], at least 3 [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], and dozens of [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters]]. They would later also possess a commandeered Republic Cruiser.<ref name="TFUvg" /> Many of their weapons and vehicles were purchased from criminal [[organization]]s, such as the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

Small in number, the Militia relied mainly on the element of surprise and hit-and-run tactics. Though vastly outnumbered by both the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and later outmatched by the much larger [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the Militia was composed of soldiers who were committed to the cause of rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU databank" /> They demonstrated qualities such as loyalty to Rahm Kota, dedication to his cause, courage against Imperial soldiers, and the willingness to [[Death/Legends|die]] for their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]].<ref name="TFUvg" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Emperor cannot discover you. Leave no witnesses. Kill everyone aboard, Imperials and Kota's men alike.|Darth Vader to Starkiller|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kota.jpg|thumb|left|200px|General Rahm Kota, Jedi Master and founder of the Militia]]
After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] quickly moved to protect the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] from the Separatist Rebellion, and thus they accepted command of the newly-formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] was determined to defend the Republic as well, although he declined to lead the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Unlike other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Kota did not trust the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Army. Furthermore, he believed that clone soldiers were unfit for battle. Kota found "real" [[Human/Legends|humans]] to be more creative, intelligent and versatile than the clones. Hence, he established a private [[unit]] of highly-trained soldiers recruited from various local militias, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and even Separatist [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war. The result was a small, but efficient fighting force, composed of soldiers noted for their battlefield effectiveness and personal loyalty to [[General/Legends|General]] Kota.<ref name="TFU databank" />

Rahm Kota's lack of trust in the clones and his faith in regular Human beings was vindicated when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious. By the Chancellor's command, the clone troopers assassinated their Jedi officers [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|on]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and throughout the galaxy. Kota's soldiers remained faithful to their General, however, and refused to obey the genocidal order. With the Republic's fall followed by the birth of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;ruled by the self-appointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine&mdash;in its place, the Militia commandeered a Republic cruiser and disappeared into hiding.<ref name="TFU databank" />

===The Dark Times===
Kota and his soldiers remained in hiding for many years during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. They emerged from seclusion nearly two decades after the [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration of a]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], conducting hit-and-run attacks against various Imperial targets throughout the galaxy. Though not officially a rebellion, their activities eventually gained the personal attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whom Kota was seeking to kill.<ref name="TFU databank" /> While Kota's Militia was in the process of raiding a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] located above [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Vader deployed his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Secret Apprentice - Galen Marek]]. Marek was a young [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]], codenamed [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], who was sent on a mission to kill Kota in Vader's stead.<ref name="TFUvg" />

[[File:Kota_and_militia.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Kota and his soldiers securing the command center of an Imperial shipyard]]
In order to protect the secrecy of his existence, as it violated the Sith [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], the Marek was ordered to kill everyone who encountered him; Imperial personnel and Kota's Militia alike. Starkiller faithfully executed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master's]] orders to the letter and allowed no one in his path to survive. Throughout his ascent to the station's command center, where General Kota was located, Starkiller came across numerous skirmishes between Imperials and Militia soldiers. Upon reaching his target, the Apprentice blinded and defeated Kota during a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], though ultimately failed to kill him. The aftermath of the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] left what remained of the Militia scattered and leaderless. Though Kota survived his encounter with Starkiller, the Jedi Master became disillusioned by his defeat and turned to extreme alcoholism in order to cope with depression.<ref name="TFUvg" />

Some of Kota's soldiers formed a bodyguard detail to the renegade [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] after the Militia's defeat at Nar Shaddaa. They accompanied him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in search of Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], unaware that she had previously been [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|killed.]] The soldiers failed to prevent the Senator's kidnapping by her [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|corrupted Jedi]] [[Maris Brood]]. Marek, who was now organizing a rebellion alongside Kota, later arrived on the planet and found the Militia troops engaged in combat with Imperial soldiers. The Militia, unaware of Starkiller's allegiance to Darth Vader, pointed the Apprentice in the direction where Brood held Organa hostage.<ref name="TFUvg" />

After Organa's [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|rescue]], a contingent of Militia soldiers journeyed to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where they provided protection to a small group of disgruntled Imperial Senators, including [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]. The meeting was actually a trap orchestrated by Darth Vader however, to lure the Emperor's enemies to a single location. The Militia was quickly overwhelmed by the Dark Lord and his [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]]; Kota was easily defeated by Vader himself. The Senators were then transferred to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] where Emperor Palpatine awaited them. The Senators were ultimately saved by Marek, who sacrificed his life [[Battle on Death Star I|in battle with Palpatine]] to ensure the survival of the Rebellion. In the aftermath of Marek's demise, the Senators&mdash;Mon Mothma, Garm Bel Iblis, Bail and Leia Organa&mdash;officially [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|declared]] the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The remnants of Kota's Militia became the basis for the fledgling [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] while Rahm Kota became one of its first generals.<ref name="TFUvg" />

===Legacy===
[[File:Kota_arrests_Vader.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader is arrested by Kota and his squad for crimes against the true Republic.]]
The newly-formed Rebel Alliance's war against the Galactic Empire eventually became too unsatisfactory in Kota's opinion. While [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] &mdash; caught between Mon Mothma's hesitancy to risk losing resources and Garm Bel Iblis's advocacy for total war &mdash; struggled with indecision and disagreement, Kota decided to wage his own war by conducting unauthorized operations against various Imperial targets.<ref name="TFU2n" /> In order to do so, he recruited an [[elite]] [[Kota's squad|squad]] that answered directly to him. Well-trained and armed with equipment similar to his previous Militia, Kota's new unit was effectively a successor to the old battalion.<ref name="TFUII databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

Using Starkiller's old [[Transport/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', as their personal transport, Kota's squad served under their General on a number of occasions, which included a [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|raid]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and an [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|Imperial ambush]] on the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] in the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]. The squad also participated in the [[Assault on Kamino]], aiding General Kota against various Imperial soldiers as the Alliance forces stormed into the [[Timira City]] Cloning Facility. As the fighting drew to a close, General Rahm Kota and his squad&mdash;aided by a [[Subject 1138|clone of the original Starkiller]] &mdash; captured Darth Vader, allowing the Alliance to secure its first major victory in the war.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

==Soldier types==
[[File:Miliz-Elite.png|thumb|right|60px|Militia Elite]]

===Elite===
The most skilled and reliable members of Kota's Militia were honored with position in the General's heavy weapons detail. Armed with large [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannons]], the Elites were regarded as more than a match for even the most battle-hardened Imperial soldiers. Their combat role included the providing of cover fire for other Militia members, as well as the defense of key positions during raids.<ref name="TFU databank" />

[[File:KotaMilitiaRocketeer_TFU_Wii.jpg|thumb|right|60px|Heavy Trooper]]

===Heavy Trooper===
Heavy Troopers utilized equipment similar to those of the Militia Saboteur, but were primarily armed with [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. They accompanied other variants of the Militia, providing long-range fire support against more heavily armored and dangerous opponents. They were effective at killing enemy targets from a distance, but were also vulnerable in close-range combat. Hence, they relied on the protection of their comrades.<ref name="TFUvg" />

[[File:KotaMilitiaSaboteur.png|thumb|right|60px|Militia Saboteur]]

===Saboteur===
The Saboteurs formed the backbone of General Kota's Militia. Armed with [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blasters]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], these soldiers were skilled at maneuvering in small, tight-knit groups. Since the Militia lacked the resources and manpower for a full-scale war against the Galactic Empire, the Saboteurs were also trained in hit-and-run tactics.<ref name="TFU databank" />

[[File:KotaMilitiaTrooper.png|thumb|right|60px|Militia Trooper]]

===Trooper===
Militia Troopers were General Kota's hand-picked soldiers, chosen to be trained in the use of energized [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]]. As such, they were mainly suited for close-quarters melee combat in environments filled with explosives and other hazards. These specialized soldiers relied on rushing at their enemies, surrounding and overwhelming them before a shot could be fired.<ref name="TFU databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The game designers of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' video game created Kota's soldiers to wear gear and designs reminiscent to those of the later Rebel troopers seen in the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The player character can be given the appearance of the Militia Elite, Saboteur or Trooper by using the cheat code SOHNDANN to unlock the other skins and costumes. The Heavy Troopers only appear in the PSP, PS2 and Wii versions of the video game.<ref name="TFUvg" /> In the PSP, PS2 and Wii versions, the Saboteurs are armed with the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]] instead of the DH-17 blaster pistol.
